title: Crossy Road Movement Effects
summary: 7 particle effect sprites. Dust puff (3 frames), confetti burst (3 frames), speech bubble (1 frame).
content:
Crossy Road Movement Effects

Overlay effects that layer on top of character sprites during animations.

Dust Puff (3 frames)

Landing impact effect. Plays when a character completes a hop.

Frame File Description Duration
1 dust-puff-1.png Small tight cluster, just starting 100ms
2 dust-puff-2.png Expanding outward, rising 100ms
3 dust-puff-3.png Wide spread, fading 100ms

Total duration: 300ms Position: Centered on character feet Trigger: Hop landing frame

Confetti Burst (3 frames)

Celebration particle effect. Pairs with celebration sprites.

Frame File Description Duration
1 confetti-burst-1.png Tight cluster, star center burst 120ms
2 confetti-burst-2.png Expanding outward, 12 pieces 120ms
3 confetti-burst-3.png Wide scatter, fading out 120ms

Total duration: 360ms Position: Centered on character Trigger: Celebration event Colors: Gold, red, cyan, green, purple, amber

Speech Bubble (1 frame)

Empty speech bubble with typing dots. Grows from anchor point via CSS.

File Description
speech-bubble.png White bubble, rounded, 3 gray dots, tail pointing down-left

Grow animation: CSS scale 0 to 1, 200ms, cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) (pop overshoot) Position: Above character head, offset right Trigger: Agent starts speaking

Bobby Integration

Dust puff

// On hop landing
function playDustPuff(x, y) {
  const frames = [1, 2, 3];
  let i = 0;
  const interval = setInterval(() => {
    setOverlay(`effects/dust-puff-${frames[i]}.png`, x, y);
    i++;
    if (i >= 3) { clearInterval(interval); removeOverlay(); }
  }, 100);
}

Confetti burst

// On celebration trigger
function playConfetti(x, y) {
  const frames = [1, 2, 3];
  let i = 0;
  const interval = setInterval(() => {
    setOverlay(`effects/confetti-burst-${frames[i]}.png`, x, y);
    i++;
    if (i >= 3) { clearInterval(interval); removeOverlay(); }
  }, 120);
}

Speech bubble

.speech-bubble-overlay {
  transform: scale(0);
  transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
}
.speech-bubble-overlay.visible {
  transform: scale(1);
}
